items.raw_excerpt: 七夕婚姻登记高峰将至，支付宝政务 AI 助手 “晓政”联合民政部民政通推出婚姻登记专项便民服务，依托 MCP 能力连接十省官方服务通道，为用户提供结婚登记预约、政策咨询、婚姻登记网点查询等服务。用户无需在多个页面反复查找，只需说出“预约结婚登记”等需求，即可快速获取对应服务及办事指引，让婚姻登记从“找服务”进一步走向“对话办”。 此次婚姻登记智能服务通过MCP接入民政通官方服务能力。针对登记条件、办理材料、办理流程、异地登记规则等高频问题，晓政还可提供AI问答和办事指引，并支持婚姻登记网点查询，帮助用户提前了解办理要求、减少重复查找。通过连接真实政务服务，晓政正推动AI从信息咨询进一步进入实际办事流程。 作为支付宝深耕数字政务领域的标准化解决方案，晓政自2025年9月正式上线以来，依托多融合大模型能力与成熟的智能服务架构，实现从“人找服务”到“服务找人、对话即办”的核心转变。目前，目前，晓政已助力100余家部委及省级政务机构搭建智能体，覆盖16000项政务服务事项，涵盖人社、公积金、公安、不动产等高频民生场景，累计服务次数突破1亿次，逐步形成可复制、可迭代的智能政务服务能力。 此次婚姻登记服务上线，进一步拓展了晓政在垂直民生场景中的应用。尤其在七夕等婚姻登记集中办理节点，通过AI承接政策咨询、服务查询及线上预约等需求，有助于提升线上服务承接效率，为线下婚姻登记服务提供协同。 未来，支付宝“晓政”将持续联合更多政务机构，通过MCP、Skill等方式推动更多真实可信的专业服务接入AI体系，让服务能力能够被AI直接调用，持续拓展高频便民服务场景，让AI从“会回答”进一步走向“会办事”。

As the Qixi Festival marriage registration peak approaches, Alipay's government AI assistant "Xiaozheng," in partnership with the Ministry of Civil Affairs' Minzheng Tong, has launched a dedicated convenience service for marriage registration. Leveraging MCP capabilities, it connects official service channels across ten provinces, offering users marriage registration appointment booking, policy consultation, and registration venue lookup. Users no longer need to search across multiple pages — simply voicing a request like "book marriage registration" quickly returns the relevant service and handling instructions, moving marriage registration from "searching for services" toward "handling via dialogue."

This marriage registration smart service integrates Minzheng Tong's official service capabilities via MCP. For high-frequency questions such as registration requirements, required materials, procedures, and cross-region registration rules, Xiaozheng provides AI Q&A and handling guidance, and supports registration venue lookup, helping users understand requirements in advance and reducing repeated searches. By connecting to real government services, Xiaozheng is advancing AI from information consultation into actual service handling.

As Alipay's standardized solution in digital government affairs, Xiaozheng has, since its official launch in September 2025, leveraged multi-modal large model capabilities and a mature intelligent service architecture to achieve a core shift from "people finding services" to "services finding people, dialogue-based handling." To date, Xiaozheng has helped over 100 ministry-level and provincial government agencies build intelligent agents, covering 16,000 government service items across high-frequency livelihood scenarios including human resources and social security, housing provident funds, public security, and real estate, with cumulative service usage exceeding 100 million times, gradually forming replicable, iterable intelligent government service capabilities. excerpt_i18n.en: The focus of the embodied intelligence industry is shifting from "capability emergence" to "productivity realization," where competition is no longer limited to single-model capability. On the afternoon of August 19, at the 2026 World Robot Conference held in Beijing, Baidu Group Vice President Yuan Foyu stated that for robots to move from "demonstration" to "deployment on the job," they require a systematic capability formed by the synergy of models, data, and applications. Baidu Group Vice President Yuan Foyu: Models are moving from understanding language to understanding and predicting the physical world. For robots to truly enter the physical world, understanding language alone is not enough; they must also understand object relationships, action consequences, and environmental changes. With the accelerated evolution of VLA, world models, and motion control, computational engineering systems face higher requirements. Yuan Foyu noted that relying on Baidu's Baige AI computing platform, Baidu AI Cloud continues to improve its AI Infra for embodied intelligence, supporting enterprises through the entire R&D process from data processing, model training, and simulation evaluation to deployment and inference on physical robots, driving models from research prototypes toward engineering systems. In some collaborations, single-step inference latency has entered the sub-100-millisecond range. Data is transforming from training material into the most critical factor of production for embodied intelligence. Embodied data collection is costly, lacks unified standards, and is highly correlated with specific embodiments, tasks, and environments. items.raw_excerpt: 8月19日消息，华尔街投行杰富瑞分析师近日对八款全球主流AI Agent 进行了真实办公任务实测，结果显示，通过模型和Harness的协同，阿里千问办公综合得分排名第一，超过美国的Claude Cowork和Codex等Agent工具。   此次测试共设置5项真实办公任务，包括基于多份文件完成公司年报摘要、联网查找并比较公司经营数据、操作真实桌面浏览器完成信息检索和文档生成、根据数据制作英文PPT，以及基于参考图片生成营销海报。测试结果显示，千问办公整体表现较为均衡，尤其在复杂办公任务、网页浏览器控制以及多模态内容生成等场景中表现突出，是唯一一个在所有测评维度中均获得90分以上的Agent产品。   报告进一步将Agent能力拆分为模型与Harness两部分进行分析。所谓Harness，是围绕模型运行的一整套工程机制，包括指令、上下文、工具调用、边界控制、反馈纠错和治理等。按照杰富瑞的测算，千问办公的“隐含Harness分”位居此次测试产品首位，高于Claude Cowork和Codex等七款国内外主流Agent产品。这也意味着，在底层模型之外，如何通过工程和产品能力将模型智能稳定转化为实际任务结果，正在成为Agent竞争的重要维度。   除任务表现外，成本也正成为Agent商业化需要考虑的重要因素。报告显示，千问办公底层Qwen 3.8 Max的API价格明显低于部分海外头部模型。由于Agent通常需要进行多轮推理、持续调用工具和执行长链路任务，企业未来衡量Agent价值时，除了模型和产品能力，也可能进一步关注“Cost per Task”，即完成一项真实任务所需的执行成本。阿里Qwen模型和千问办公Agent的组合体现出较好的性能与成本优势。   过去几个月，Agent的竞争正在从个人办公转向企业级场景。报告认为，对于企业级Age

excerpt_i18n.en: On August 19, Jefferies analysts tested eight mainstream global AI Agents on real office tasks. Results showed that through the synergy of model and Harness, Alibaba's Qwen Office ranked first in comprehensive score, surpassing US Agent tools such as Claude Cowork and Codex. The test included five real office tasks: summarizing annual reports based on multiple documents, searching and comparing company operating data online, operating a real desktop browser to complete information retrieval and document generation, creating English PPTs from data, and generating marketing posters based on reference images. Results showed Qwen Office performed in a relatively balanced manner overall, excelling particularly in complex office tasks, web browser control, and multimodal content generation, and was the only Agent product to score above 90 in all evaluation dimensions. The report further analyzed Agent capabilities by splitting them into model and Harness. The so-called Harness is a full set of engineering mechanisms running around the model, including instructions, context, tool calls, boundary control, feedback correction, and governance. According to Jefferies' calculations, Qwen Office's "implicit Harness score" ranked first among the tested products, higher than seven mainstream domestic and international Agent products including Claude Cowork and Codex. This also implies that beyond the underlying model, engineering and product capabilities matter.
excerpt_i18n.es: Noticias del 19 de agosto. Analistas del banco de inversión estadounidense Jefferies probaron recientemente ocho agentes de IA globales en tareas reales de oficina. Los resultados muestran que, mediante la sinergia entre el modelo y el harness, Ali Qwen obtuvo la puntuación integral más alta en tareas de oficina, superando a herramientas de agente como Claude Cowork y Codex de Estados Unidos. La prueba incluyó cinco tareas reales de oficina: elaborar un resumen del informe anual de una empresa basado en múltiples documentos, buscar y comparar datos operativos de empresas en Internet, operar un navegador de escritorio real para realizar búsqueda de información y generación de documentos, crear una presentación en PPT en inglés a partir de datos, y generar un póster de marketing basado en imágenes de referencia.
